Один адрес для панели и для игроков, не: One address for the panel and for players, not the Minecraft login port. A domain without a port means HTTPS through a proxy you already run; a direct connection is IP:3077. A server on this same computer is http://127.0.0.1:3077, but players on other machines need an address they can reach.
Пароль из server.properties вашего серве: The password from your server's server.properties. With it the panel runs console commands and can fetch the pairing code itself; without it, commands go through the UDMC Agent. RCON does not encrypt the password: over the internet use a VPN or the UDMC console over HTTPS.
